supersedes.reason: The first audit subtracted one shared nominal branch from classifier inputs and labeled only the initial treatment direction.

claims_allowed: P0 distinguishes perturbation presence in the deterministic held-out simulation pairs.
claims_not_allowed: The audit establishes robustness to real sensor noise or real robot transfer.
P1 is deployable before simulator-to-real right-wrist viewpoint correspondence is verified.
P0 or P1 identifies all four controlled perturbation directions at the required accuracy.
split_unit: paired simulated audit Episodes; disjoint amplitude fractions; one raw branch sample per Episode at each delay
direction_score_definition: Minimum of balanced initial-treatment direction accuracy and macro recall for paired current-error direction; both must support a four-way claim.

P0.inputs: q, dq, frozen nominal action, command-feedback residual, gripper width, phase/history

P1.inputs: P0 plus RGB-only yellow-housing-to-finger relative XY, visibility and confidence
P1.deployment_blocker: Archived metadata says current hardware extrinsics are unverified; real-data read is denied.

representation: Raw deployable P0/P1 history; no paired nominal subtraction is applied to classifier inputs.
limitations: All pairs originate from the one frozen frame-97 snapshot; nominal branches are separately executed but deterministic.
Metrics establish treatment sensitivity only in the frozen simulator and do not include real sensor noise.
